title: Inventory: Storey, Akey & Kruglyak 2005 (PLoS Biol 3:e267) supporting information
intro: Generated by `ingest/inventory.py` from `sources/storey2005/raw/`. Both supporting tables were fetched
and saved untouched; PLOS sends no filename, so the extension (.pdf) was set from the file content.
The article page is `sources/storey2005/article.html`. The other identifiers on the page (e001-e011, ex001-ex026,
g001-g003) are inline equations and figures, not supplementary files. Checksums are in `MANIFEST.tsv`.
Faithful text extractions of both tables, with PDF page and line for every row, are in `extracted/`
(made by `extracted/extract.py`; each TSV names its source file's SHA-256).

roles.journal.pbio.0030267.st001.pdf: Table S1: the 170 expression traits with joint linkage to two loci at FDR <= 10%: trait ORF and its coordinates, chromosome and marker position of locus 1 (primary) and locus 2 (secondary), joint q-value, and a cis flag (0 none, 1 cis to locus 1, 2 cis to locus 2). PDF, 2 pages.
roles.journal.pbio.0030267.st002.pdf: Table S2: the 10 pair-wise 50-kb bins holding three or more of those linkages (61 rows): group, trait, locus positions, joint FDR, cis flag and a putative group function. PDF, 1 page.

missing: No single-locus (1D) linkage results, LOD scores or effect sizes per trait; the tables give marker positions and the joint q-value only.
No intervals around the loci: each locus is one marker position.
No genotype or expression data (published earlier by Brem et al. 2002 / Yvert et al. 2003 / Brem & Kruglyak 2005).
No list of the 3,540 / 4,271 traits significant at a 5% FDR under the looser one-locus-linked definition; only the 170 joint linkages are tabulated.
